shortDescription: V2 core BUILT (branch v2-spike, green): ONE Map with 3 stacked bands, stairs as Building_Door wormhole portals joined by a synthetic RegionLink, movement segmented at Pawn_PathFollower. Parity inherited from vanilla instead of emulated by V1's ~130 patches. Untested in game.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

---

# ARCHITECTURE V2 — BUILT 2026-07-26, branch `v2-spike`, green 0/0, UNTESTED IN GAME

## Why the pivot (the diagnosis)
V1 runs **three separate `Map` objects** pretending to be one. Every parity bug is structural:
- **`IntVec3` is not level-qualified.** Cell (5,5) exists on all three maps; any vanilla API taking a cell with an implicit map is ambiguous. Only interceptable, one call site at a time, forever.
- **`Thing.mapIndexOrState` is one `sbyte`.** `thing.Map == pawn.Map` is false across levels, and that comparison is everywhere in vanilla *and every other mod* → compat surface scales with the modding ecosystem and never converges.
- **The core mechanism is lying.** `ABVirtualPosition` `FieldRef`-mutates `positionInt` + `mapIndexOrState`, runs a vanilla scan, restores — 43 call sites / 16 files. Mid-lie the pawn isn't really there; re-entrancy is held off by a global `VirtualScanActive` bool.
- **Decision ≠ execution.** Cross-level scans are existence probes whose job is discarded then re-resolved after arrival → walk to stairs, arrive, nothing there, walk back. Compensated by **289 cooldown/budget/memo/throttle refs across 34 files** — dampers for a model that cannot commit.
- **Reachability + reservations stop at the map edge** → `StairRouter`/`StairIslands`/`CrossLevelDemand` hand-reimplement region reachability and the reservation manager. Two claim systems ⇒ double-claims and stalls.
- `DrawPosOffsetPatcher` (hundreds of DrawPos getters patched on ParallelPreDraw worker threads) exists *solely* because the level below is a different Map.

## The V2 model
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)` where `Slot = bandHeight + Gutter`. Bands stack along **+z** so each band is a CONTIGUOUS `CellIndices` range (row-major `z*sizeX+x`) — that's why +z, not +x. `band = surfaceBand + level`; higher band = higher z = higher level (basement / surface / sky, bottom to top). A **2-row impassable open-air Gutter** between bands guarantees no region, room, temperature zone or section mesh ever spans a seam implicitly.

| Mechanism | How |
|---|---|
| Connectivity | Stair pair = two `RegionType.Portal` regions sharing ONE synthetic `RegionLink`. `Region.Neighbors` is topological, not spatial, so distant regions sharing a link ARE adjacent. `Reachability.CanReach` (managed region-BFS) then works unpatched, which transitively fixes `ClosestThingReachable` / `RegionTraverser` / storage search / every `WorkGiver_Scanner` |
| Rooms & temperature | `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom` + `AllowsMultipleRegionsPerDistrict` ⇒ connectivity conducts, rooms/temp/vacuum stay separate |
| Movement | `Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath` prefix segments cross-band trips; `PatherArrived` prefix teleports + re-dispatches. ONE interception covers every job, pawn, faction and third-party JobDriver |
| Reservations | Single `reservationManager` — double-claims impossible |
| Band isolation (render) | **Free**: `MapDrawer.DrawMapMesh` only draws sections overlapping the camera ViewRect, so clamping the camera to the band IS "hide other levels". No DrawPos patching at all |

### Hard 1.6 constraint (verified from source)
**The pathfinder is jobified** — `PathFinderJob` (`IJob` over `NativeArray` + `NativePriorityQueue`), `PathGridJob` (`IJobParallelFor`). A* neighbour expansion is NOT patchable. All custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`. `PathRequest.ValidateInt` gates on `pawn.CanReach`, so reachability and path production must be widened together or you get silent `PawnPath.NotFound` loops. 1.6 removed the non-adjacent-cell assert in `SetupMoveIntoNextCell`, so a wormhole step is tolerated.

## V2 FILES BUILT (`Source/V2/`, all green)
- **`ABBandMap.cs`** — `MapComponent`, the persisted layout: `bandCount`/`bandHeight`/`surfaceBand`/`openedBands`. `BandOf` = one integer divide. `Translate(cell, band)` keeps the column aligned 1:1 (a stairwell's far end is directly above/below). `Gutter = 2`.
- **`ABBands.cs`** — allocation-free facade every other system uses (`Banded`/`BandOf`/`SameBand`/`LevelOf`/`RectOfBand`/`IsSurface`), CWT-cached. Retains the spike's `TestRect` layout.
- **`ABWormhole.cs`** — THE load-bearing primitive. Synthetic `RegionLink` shared by two Portal regions; re-arm postfix on `RegionAndRoomUpdater.TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (mandatory — `RegionDirtyer` clears `reg.links` on every rebuild). Never routed through `regionLinkDatabase.LinkFrom` (span-hash collision). Ends typed `Building_Door`. `TryGetTransit` = whole-trip-optimal pair.
- **`ABWormholePather.cs`** — `StartPath` prefix segments; `PatherArrived` prefix consumes arrival, teleports, re-dispatches (clears the record BEFORE re-dispatch to avoid recursion; `Notify_Teleported(endCurrentJob:false)` so the job survives the hop).
- **`ABBandedGeneration.cs`** — `ABV2` master switch + both generation hooks on `MapGenerator.GenerateMap`: PREFIX inflates `mapSize.z` (caller's IntVec3 untouched, so `World.info.initialMapSize` stays the SURFACE size — critical, every other map is sized from it); POSTFIX carves non-surface bands (rock below w/ ore, open air above), cuts gutters, refogs, and moves `MapGenerator.PlayerStartSpot` into the surface band (scenario pawns spawn AFTER gen via `Find.Scenario.PostMapGenerate`, so this lands the starting colony correctly). Banding applies only to player `Settlement` maps, never pocket maps.
- **`Building_ABStairs2.cs`** — V2 stairwell, `Building_Door` subclass (`AlwaysOpen`/`FreePassage`/`PawnCanOpen` overridden: a shaft, not a door). On spawn: carve far-side landing, spawn counterpart at the aligned cell, link wormhole, open the target band. Destroying one end collapses the other.
- **`ABBandView.cs`** — current band per map, band switching preserving in-band x/z + zoom, and a `CameraDriver.Update` postfix that re-clamps `rootPos.z` into the band.
- **`ABBandEnv.cs`** — per-band biome resolver + plant-density gate (`GetBaseDesiredPlantsCountAt` postfix — a banded map has 3× cells, so unpatched it would triple plant spawning) + per-band temperature offset (`TryGetTemperatureForCell` postfix, outdoors only) + **map-edge redirect** (`CellFinder.RandomEdgeCell` / `TryFindRandomEdgeCellWith` → the surface band's own perimeter, since `touchesMapEdge` is only true at the basement floor and sky ceiling).
- **`ABBandInput.cs`** — own `GameComponent` (never edits V1's `ABGameComp`). PageUp/PageDown + **Ctrl**+wheel (Ctrl not Shift — Shift+wheel is rerouted to the horizontal axis by OS/Unity IMGUI, zeroing vertical delta; V1 learned this twice).
- **`ABDevTools.V2.cs` / `.V2Spike.cs`** — band info, open-all-bands, place stairs, plus the sealed-chamber wormhole spike.
- **`Defs/V2/AB2_Stairs.xml`** — `AB2_StairsDown`/`AB2_StairsUp` (DoorBase-derived, `ABBandStairsExt.levelDelta`). **`Defs/V2/AB2_Spike.xml`** — spike anchor.

### V1 interlock
V1 goes inert on a banded map **by itself** — all its machinery keys off `map.Levels()?.upperMap/lowerMap`, which stay null since no pocket levels are generated. The only explicit guard added: `LevelMapGen.GetOrGenerate` refuses to grow V1 levels on a banded map (single edit to a V1 file).

## KNOWN LIMITATIONS / NOT YET BUILT
1. **Coastline / river / road fidelity.** The surface band is a horizontal slice of a 3×-tall generated map, so tile features anchored to the MAP EDGE — coastlines above all — can land in a carved band and be lost. Continuous noise (elevation, fertility, rock) slices correctly. **Real fix = Stage 4 transplant.**
2. **Stage 4 transplant NOT built.** Deliberately: it's ~500 lines of map surgery (terrain/roof/fog/things/pawns/zones/areas/designations + `MapParent` reassignment) that cannot be validated blind. It is the right generation path (generate a normal map at full vanilla fidelity, move it into band 1) and doubles as the save-migration path and the true-lazy trigger.
3. **"Lazy" is currently lazy-REVEAL, not lazy-cost.** Bands exist physically from generation (fogged, inert) and are opened by building stairs. The 3× grid/`PathGridJob` cost is paid from turn one. True lazy needs #2.
4. **See-below underlay not built.** Band isolation works (camera clamp), but drawing the level below as an underlay isn't implemented. Much easier here than V1 (same map, sections already exist — a translated `Graphics.DrawMesh`) but not done.
5. **V1 code still present** on the branch, inert. Deletion is Stage 2 proper, after V2 proves out.
6. **Biome regression** — see below.

### PER-BAND BIOMES (V2's one genuine regression)
`Map.Biome => TileInfo.PrimaryBiome` is **one get-only biome per Map**. V1 gets per-level biomes FREE because levels are pocket maps and `PocketMapProperties.biome` overrides the tile biome (powers `AB_Underground`, `AB_OpenSky`, `skyBiomeInherit`, the Caverns picker, the Alpha Biomes carve list). V2 resolves it explicitly via `ABBandEnv.BiomeOf(map, cell)`.
- **Cheap** (biome asked WITH a cell): plant spawning, terrain gen, fertility. Done.
- **Needs care:** wild animals (biome picked to choose the ANIMAL, then a cell — inverted order); ambient sound; disease MTB; Odyssey `inVacuum`.
- **Gets BETTER:** `AB_Underground`'s `baseWeatherCommonalities: Clear` + `plantDensity: 0` is V1 *simulating* "indoors" with a fake biome — the reason `LevelClimate`/`ClimateSync` exist. In V2 the basement is roofed rock, so no rain/snow/skylight comes from the **roof grid**, exactly as vanilla handles indoor space. Sky band unroofed → real weather.
- **Regression:** third-party biome-aware mods read `map.Biome` directly and see the surface biome everywhere. Fix = explicit resolver + bridges (we already ship `BiomesCavernsCompat`).
- **REJECTED:** a contextual `Map.Biome` getter override driven by an ambient "current cell" latch — precisely the lying-to-vanilla-behind-a-global-latch pattern that made V1 unmaintainable.

## LOCKED DESIGN DECISIONS (user, 2026-07-26)
1. **Save break: ACCEPTED.** V2 will not load V1 multi-map saves.
2. **Banding LAZY** (currently lazy-reveal; true lazy needs transplant). Swappable policy — runtime model is identical either way, only the creation trigger differs.
3. **"Levels", not "columns".** One map, three layers.
4. **Stairs are a `Building_Door` subclass.** Done.
5. **Perf ceiling accepted + disclosed.** 250-wide × 3 bands ≈ 187k cells. About description must **warn that extra floors on large maps cost performance**.

## THE TEST THAT DECIDES EVERYTHING
**Assertion 5, not scriptable:** a colonist must haul 50 steel out of a SEALED chamber (no door, no gap — the only connection is a synthetic `RegionLink`) with ZERO hauling code written. If vanilla does cross-band logistics for free, V2 is proven and V1's ~110 patches can be deleted. Scripted assertions 1–4 (`CanReach` crosses · both ends Portal · rooms did NOT merge · `ClosestThingReachable` finds the sealed-in item · segmentation resolves a pair) run via **"AB2: spike - run assertions"** and write `docs/SelfTest.log`.
**Kill criterion:** if 1 or 2 fails, STOP — Option A is dead; fall back to a column-index + composite-managers refactor of V1.

## Rejected alternatives (kept so they stay rejected)
- **Column database / shadow index** — fixes ping-pong but **vanilla never queries your database**; all ~130 interceptions and the ambiguity ceiling remain. 60% fix.
- **Composite managers** — patches choke points not call sites, but breaks when a consumer feeds a widened result into `map.thingGrid.ThingsAt(pos)`.
- **Vanilla `MapPortal` de-scope** — never bugs out; abandons the goal. The stability floor.
- **Time-multiplexed parallel grids** (Z-Levels Beta / MultiFloors style) — only one level simulated at a time; off-level pawns freeze. ❌

---

# V1 (SHIPPED) — multi-map architecture
Workshop `3767572810`. ~130 Harmony patches widening map-scoped questions to the column via `LevelExtensions`, gated by `LevelCensus` static perf gates. 165 C# files / ~42.5k LOC. Levels are pocket maps (hence free per-level biomes). R1–R4 refactor + GC micro-pass done, green, unpublished. Compat: PUAH · LWM/Adaptive Storage · DBH/VEF/Rimefeller · Odyssey · Misc. Robots · Allow Tool · CE · CAI 5000. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata.

## TESTING RULE
isolated=true always. Companions: **always `astryl.ModernDevTools`**; **NOT Melee Animation**. **Palette pins get culled at startup for Playing-gated debug actions ("Could not find node… Removing" — harmless RimWorld quirk); run from the Debug Actions menu instead.** V2 banding only applies to a **NEW colony** (generation-time), so testing V2 needs a fresh game, not quicktest's existing map — quicktest generates a new player settlement map, which qualifies.

## Status
2026-07-26: **V2 core built end-to-end on branch `v2-spike`, green 0/0, never run.** Band model + wormhole + movement segmentation + generation + camera + environment + input + dev tools. Transplant (Stage 4), see-below underlay, and V1 deletion deliberately deferred. Next action is the first in-game run: verify assertions 1–5, then band generation on a new colony.
